title: Sum-Capture for Nonlinear Bijections
summary: The sum-capture theorem currently applies only to linear bijections; whether it extends to nonlinear bijections on binary vector spaces remains open.

formal_statement.body: Extend the sum-capture theorem from $\Gamma\in GL(n)$ to nonlinear bijections $\Gamma:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$.

scope.domain: Sum-capture analysis of bijective key-derivation mappings on binary vector spaces.
assumptions: The current sum-capture theorem requires the mapping Gamma to be a linear bijection.
parameters: n: dimension of the binary vector space
Gamma: the bijection from the binary vector space to itself
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the sum-capture theorem can be extended from linear bijections to nonlinear bijections of the binary vector space.

progress.summary: The paper states that its results apply only to linear bijective key-derivation functions because the sum-capture proof requires linear mappings. It explicitly asks whether the theorem extends to nonlinear bijections.
citation_labels: Shan Chen et al., Minimizing the Two-Round Even-Mansour Cipher
